item.title: Toyota Fluorite: "console-grade" Flutter game engine
item.description:
📝 Game Engine Fluorite is the first console-grade game engine fully integrated with Flutter. At the same time, it allows you to write game code using familiar high-level game APIs in Dart, making most of your game development knowledge transferrable from other engines. Your browser does not support the video tag.
🔗 Read more: https://fluorite.game/
